title: Godfidence
subtitle: In this 4 session faith-based video series you will learn;
description: Have you ever wished you had more confidence? Life can be a hard task master at times and toxic relationships can really wear you down, including your self-esteem and confidence. We will explore where your value comes from, and who determines it. We will also look at how shame affects your identity and ultimately your confidence negatively. I will provide you with tools to build confidence that lasts forever.

bullets.text: How faith can change the way you see yourself
How shame destroys identity and erodes confidence

testimonial.quote: I highly recommend and endorse the teachings and the books by Mark. You too can be empowered for greatness by applying the principles of Mark’s teachings. Experience TRUE LIFE CHANGE
testimonial.author: Rory Franks

lessons.title: Building Godfidence Part 1
lessons.body: Welcome to Godfidence, building confidence that lasts forever! This 4 video series is a faith based life changing course. Regardless of background the principles taught are a practical process for building confidence and help you discover your value. To be clear they are biblical based principals but taught in a way you never have heard before. It is not your typical religious approach but a very practical and life applied one! Thank you for downloading this course. Remember to download your notes to follow along.

lessons.title: Building Godfidence Part 2
lessons.body: Welcome to part 2 of Godfidence I hope you enjoyed the first video. In this video and the next I am going to share about how to break shame off your life and give your very practical ways to overcome it. Fasten your seatbelts this is a powerful section. Remember to download your notes!

lessons.title: Building Godfidence Part 3
lessons.body: Welcome to part 3 of Godfidence! In this video I continue the second part of overcoming shame. This is a powerful video and I encourage you to open your heart and mind to healing and forgiveness. Remember to download your notes page.

lessons.title: Building Godfidence Part 4
lessons.body: Welcome to the final installment of Godfidence, building confidence that lasts forever! I hope this has been life changing for you so far. In this last video I use scripture to lay a clear understanding of how to live with confidence. The results of living this out is an abundant life and healthy relationships.
